title: How Long You'd Last on Each Planet

hook.text:
HOW LONG YOU'D
LAST ON PLANETS

segments.text: On one planet, you'd last less than a second.
Start on Mercury. With no air, you'd pass out in 15 seconds.
And you'd be gone in about 2 minutes.
Mars is no better. Its air is too thin, so about 2 minutes again.
But Venus is the deadliest. Its air presses 90 times harder than Earth's.
And it's 465 degrees Celsius, hot enough to melt lead.
You'd be crushed and cooked in less than a second!
Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune have no ground at all.
You'd sink through the clouds until the pressure crushes you too.
The only planet where you'd last a lifetime? The one you're on right now.
